audit.description: Changed production code removes direct colorama imports from repopack/utils/cli_output.py and repopack/utils/logger.py and replaces them with real Rich APIs, including rich.console.Console, rich.text.Text, rich.logging.RichHandler, and rich.markup.escape. Static and dynamic evidence show target imports and runtime target events from production repo files, while source colorama imports are absent from production repo code; the only observed colorama imports are from third-party dependencies outside the repo. There is no evidence of a local rich provider or shim, and target origins resolve to site-packages/rich rather than repository code.
evidence: Unified diff: repopack/utils/cli_output.py removes import colorama and from colorama import Fore, Style; adds from rich.console import Console and from rich.text import Text; uses _console.print and Text.assemble

Unified diff: repopack/utils/logger.py removes from colorama import Fore, Style, init and ColoredFormatter; adds RichHandler, Console, and escape from rich modules; logging methods call escape(message) and RichHandler is installed
Static anti-cheat file checks: repopack/utils/cli_output.py and repopack/utils/logger.py have imports_target=true, imports_source=false, dynamic_imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false
Dynamic evidence: first target import from production repo is rich.console in repopack/utils/logger.py with origin under site-packages/rich/__init__.py; target_events_from_production_repo_count=23
Dynamic evidence: source_imports_from_production_repo_count=0 and source_imports_from_repo_count=0; two colorama imports are from site-packages/log_symbols and site-packages/halo only
Dynamic evidence: target_local_spec_count=0, supporting no local Rich shim/provider
reasons: Production files import and use Rich APIs directly
Changed production code no longer imports colorama
Observed colorama imports come only from dependencies outside the repo
No local fake Rich provider or target shim detected
